authority.approval_basis: Owner instruction to proceed with the recommended bounded-preview posture

scope: bounded regional, public-datasets-only, non-operational technical preview
open_gates: 90 consecutive beta days and three operational cycles
rollback_and_revocation: quarantine affected outputs on integrity, rights or safety failure
withdraw or correct affected publication artifacts
reset affected elapsed gate after a qualifying interruption or revision change
record a successor decision before restoring a withdrawn scope
non_claims: This is not beta, release-candidate or stable-v1 approval.
Agent-panel assessment cannot substitute for factual external participant evidence.
The decision does not assert national completeness, operational authority or clinical validity.
